description: This Java class 'GlobalConfigurationValidationService' performs validation of global configuration names across tenants in the Fineract platform. It implements initialization logic to validate configuration names against a pattern, retrieving tenant data and configuration names from a database.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationValidationService
classes.description: Service class that validates global configuration names for tenants during application startup.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initialization method called after bean properties are set; triggers validation of configuration names.

methods.name: validateGlobalConfigurationNames
methods.description: Retrieves all tenants and validates their global configuration names.

methods.name: validateGlobalConfigurationForIndividualTenant
methods.description: Validates configuration names for a specific tenant, throwing an exception if any name does not match the pattern.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigurationNames
methods.description: Fetches the list of global configuration names for a given tenant from the database.
